test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 03 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Aarohi has to reach Lucknow which is 907 km away in 14 hours. His starting speed for 5 hours was 32 km/hr. For the next 81 km his speed was 27 km/hr. By what speed he must travel now so as to reach Lucknow in the decided time of 14 hours?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Total Distance** = 907 km | **Total Time** = 14 hours

**D₁** = 5 × 32 = 160 km | **T₂** = 81 ÷ 27 = 3 hours

**Remaining Distance** = 907 − (160 + 81) = 666 km

**Remaining Time** = 14 − (5 + 3) = 6 hours

**Required Speed** = 666 ÷ 6 = 111 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 111 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27d462160c4727cdc9e621013fced719f7bbeffc39d736668ba9f5724b1b7308.png] 

**Given:**

Total distance = 907 km, Total time limit = 14 hours

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Distance₁** = Speed₁ × Time₁ = 32 × 5 = 160 km

⇒ **Time₂** = Distance₂ ÷ Speed₂ = 81 ÷ 27 = 3 hours

⇒ **Total Distance covered** = 160 + 81 = 241 km

⇒ **Total Time elapsed** = 5 + 3 = 8 hours

⇒ **Remaining Distance** = 907 − 241 = 666 km

⇒ **Remaining Time** = 14 − 8 = 6 hours

⇒ **Required Speed** = Remaining Distance ÷ Remaining Time = 666 ÷ 6 = 111 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 111 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

It is the total distance traveled divided by the total time taken. **Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time**.

Basic Speed Formula

Relationship between **Distance (D)**, **Speed (S)**, and **Time (T)** is given by D = S × T.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.</p
